_comment: One fight night recorded whole, for test_every_bout_is_its_own_fight.py: ESPN's UFC scoreboard for UFC 331: Van vs. Pantoja 2 (event 600060963) as the Wayback Machine captured it four times. Each capture's events are unedited; the payload's leagues, season, day and provider blocks, which nothing here reads, are left out. The card is ONE event with twelve competitions (bouts) in running order, early prelims first. Each bout carries its own date, its segment's start (21:30Z early prelims, 23:00Z prelims, 01:00Z main card); the event date, 21:00Z, is the card's opening time. Across all 103 captures of this endpoint from 2026 (1,259 bouts), every card under way had exactly one bout in state 'in', every scheduled bout had displayClock '-', and every bout had its own date.

captures.name: fight_day_morning
captures.note: 12:51:45 UTC on fight day. All twelve bouts STATUS_SCHEDULED (state pre), displayClock '-'. Nothing is live.
